DISCHARGE SUMMARY (SYNTHETIC)
Patient: Eleanor Park   Age: 78   Sex: F
Admit: 09/21/2026   Discharge: 09/26/2026
Attending: Dr. R. Okafor, Orthopedics

Principal diagnosis: Closed displaced intertrochanteric fracture of right femur, s/p open reduction internal fixation (ORIF) on 09/22/2026.

Hospital course: Presented after a mechanical fall at home. ORIF was uncomplicated. Incision clean, dry and intact with staples in place; staple removal due 10/06/2026. Started enoxaparin 40 mg subcutaneous daily x 28 days for DVT prophylaxis. Pain controlled with acetaminophen and oxycodone 2.5 mg PRN.

Past medical history:
- Type 2 diabetes mellitus with diabetic peripheral neuropathy, on insulin glargine 18 units nightly. A1c 8.9% on 09/21/2026. Reports numbness in both feet; monofilament sensation decreased bilaterally.
- Chronic kidney disease stage 3b, baseline eGFR 38.
- Major depressive disorder, recurrent, on sertraline 100 mg daily.
- Hypertension, on amlodipine 5 mg daily.

Functional status: Ambulates 40 feet with front-wheeled walker and contact guard assist. Requires assistance with lower body dressing and bathing. Leaving home requires a considerable and taxing effort and the assistance of another person.

Disposition: Home with home health. Lives with husband (age 81) in a second-floor apartment with elevator.

Home health orders: Skilled nursing for incision care, enoxaparin injection teaching, diabetes management and medication reconciliation. Physical therapy for gait training and fall prevention. Occupational therapy evaluation for ADLs.

Face-to-face encounter: Performed by Dr. R. Okafor on 09/25/2026; findings support homebound status and the need for skilled nursing and therapy.

Follow-up: Orthopedic clinic 10/06/2026.
nurse_summary: 78F s/p R hip ORIF after fall. Needs SN for incision care + Lovenox teaching, PT/OT. HTN. Walker, homebound. Lives w/ husband. OK to accept.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY (SYNTHETIC)
Patient: Walter Brooks   Age: 82   Sex: M
Admit: 09/22/2026   Discharge: 09/26/2026
Attending: Dr. L. Fernandez, Hospital Medicine

Principal diagnosis: Acute on chronic diastolic (HFpEF) heart failure exacerbation.

Hospital course: Admitted with 9 lb weight gain, bilateral leg edema and dyspnea. Diuresed with IV furosemide, transitioned to oral furosemide 40 mg twice daily. Discharge weight 212 lb. Echo: EF 60%, grade II diastolic dysfunction.

Past medical history:
- COPD, on home oxygen 2 L via nasal cannula at night and with exertion.
- Persistent atrial fibrillation, rate controlled on metoprolol; anticoagulated with apixaban 5 mg twice daily.
- Hypertension.
- Obesity, BMI 36.

Skin: Nursing documented a stage 2 pressure injury of the sacrum on 09/24/2026, 2 x 1.5 cm, partial thickness, no tunneling. Foam dressing applied.

Functional status: Short of breath after walking 20 feet; uses a rollator and oxygen. Leaving home requires a taxing effort and the help of his daughter.

Disposition: Home with home health. Lives with daughter.

Home health orders: Skilled nursing for heart failure monitoring, daily weights, diuretic and medication teaching, and wound care to sacral pressure injury. Physical therapy for endurance and safe mobility.

Face-to-face encounter: To be completed at PCP follow-up visit; not documented during this admission.

Follow-up: PCP within 7 days; cardiology in 2 weeks.
nurse_summary: 82M CHF exacerbation. Needs SN for CHF teaching + daily weights, PT. On O2. MA plan - needs auth. F2F missing. Pending.

Patient: Rosa Delgado   Age: 86   Sex: F
SNF stay: 09/05/2026 - 09/26/2026 (after hospitalization for sepsis from urinary tract infection)
Attending: Dr. S. Patel

- Type 2 diabetes mellitus, diet controlled.

Functional status: Transfers with one-person assist. Requires help with bathing, dressing, toileting and meals. Leaving home requires the assistance of another person and a wheelchair.

Disposition: Home with daughter, who is the primary caregiver and works part time.

Home health orders: Skilled nursing for negative pressure wound therapy and wound assessment three times weekly; caregiver teaching for pressure injury prevention.

Face-to-face encounter: Completed by Dr. S. Patel on 09/24/2026; supports homebound status and skilled nursing need.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY (SYNTHETIC)
Patient: Harold Jensen   Age: 79   Sex: M
Admit: 09/23/2026   Discharge: 09/26/2026
Attending: Dr. M. Chen, Hospital Medicine

Principal diagnosis: Community-acquired pneumonia, right lower lobe, resolved.

Hospital course: Treated with IV ceftriaxone and azithromycin, transitioned to oral antibiotics and completed course in hospital. Afebrile for 48 hours, oxygen saturation 96% on room air.

Past medical history: Hypertension. Benign prostatic hyperplasia. Army veteran, served in Vietnam 1968-1970.

Functional status: PT evaluation on 09/25/2026: ambulates 300 feet independently without a device; independent with stairs. Patient is not homebound. No skilled nursing or therapy needs identified.

Social: Lives alone. Case manager notes general deconditioning; patient reports difficulty bathing safely, preparing meals and keeping up with housekeeping since his wife passed away last year.

Disposition: Home. Hospitalist requested home health evaluation; case manager recommends non-medical in-home support.
nurse_summary: 79M PNA resolved. Independent 300 ft, not homebound, no skilled need. Decline.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY (SYNTHETIC)
Patient: Linda Chen   Age: 62   Sex: F
Admit: 09/18/2026   Discharge: 09/26/2026
Attending: Dr. A. Gupta, Neurology

Principal diagnosis: Acute ischemic stroke, right middle cerebral artery territory, with left-sided hemiparesis.

Hospital course: Received thrombolysis within window. MRI confirmed right MCA infarct. Started aspirin and atorvastatin 80 mg. Speech-language pathology identified mild oropharyngeal dysphagia; on mechanical soft diet with thin liquids.

Past medical history: Hyperlipidemia. Type 2 diabetes mellitus on metformin.

Functional status: Transfers with moderate assist. Walks 15 feet with hemi-walker and assistance. Requires help with bathing, dressing, toileting and transfers. Leaving home requires the assistance of another person and a wheelchair.

Disposition: Home with husband. Still employed; covered by employer PPO plan.

Home health orders: Skilled nursing for stroke education, blood sugar and medication management. Physical therapy, occupational therapy, and speech-language pathology for dysphagia.

Face-to-face encounter: Completed by Dr. A. Gupta on 09/25/2026; supports homebound status and skilled need.
nurse_summary: 62F R MCA stroke, L hemiparesis. Needs SN, PT/OT/SLP. BlueRidge PPO - not contracted.
